title: LookaheadDelay — circular buffer, host latency reporting
description:
Implement Source/DSP/LookaheadDelay as a realtime-safe main-path circular delay with discrete lookahead times and exact host latency reporting support.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md section 17 (Lookahead values, N_L formula, zero default, no hidden latency)
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §13 / latency notes: reported latency includes main-path lookahead; default 0 samples
- Source/ParameterIDs.h for global.lookahead if present
- Existing Source/DSP/* prepare/reset/process style (fixed storage, no audio-thread alloc) and Source/DSP/FractionalDelay.* for delay-line patterns if present

Implement LookaheadDelay.h/.cpp per spec §17:
- Discrete lookahead set: Off, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10 ms. Default Off (zero samples of delay).
- N_L = round(tau_L * fs); x_D[n] = x[n - N_L] via a circular buffer preallocated in prepare(sampleRate, maxBlockSize, numChannels).
- process (or processBlock) delays multi-channel wet/main audio in place or into a caller buffer; channels share the same delay length.
- setLookaheadMs / setLookaheadEnum accepting only the discrete set (clamp or snap nearest legal value); getLatencySamples() returns N_L exactly for the active setting.
- Seamless transitions when lookahead changes: crossfade or write-head hop that avoids clicks/pops (document approach); no zipper on wet path.
- prepare/reset; no heap allocation on the audio path after prepare. Cap buffer for max 10 ms at max supported SR (e.g. 192 kHz) with fixed storage.
- Do NOT call AudioProcessor::setLatencySamples here — g.4 owns host reporting via getLatencySamples() from this unit plus any alignment main-path delay.

Do NOT implement StereoLinker, AnomalyGuard, or PluginProcessor wiring. Do NOT edit CMakeLists.txt (g.4). Do NOT write tests (g.5).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: LookaheadDelay supports discrete settings Off/0.25/0.5/1/2/5/10 ms with default Off (N_L=0)
Delay length uses N_L = round(tau_L * fs) via a circular buffer sized in prepare
getLatencySamples() returns the exact active main-path delay in samples
Lookahead setting changes do not produce hard clicks (smoothed or crossfaded transition)
No heap allocation in the per-block process path after prepare
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: use plain C++20 + JUCE AudioBuffer/HeapBlock preallocated in prepare
snap illegal ms values to nearest legal discrete setting
crossfade on lookahead length change within a few ms
forbidden: implement stereo linking or anomaly detection inside this unit
report hidden latency beyond explicit N_L
